Name: These Boots are Made for Hiding (Small boots for long skirts) Fashion Sense
Author: LooneyLuny
Description:
UPDATED VERSION HERE: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/31744?tab=description&jump_to_comment=150300422]Small Boots For All[/url]

Ever find a really cute long dress mod and try it on only to find your farmers big feet clipping through the front when you run? No more! These boots make your farmer's feet tiny and easily hidden! Depending on the skirt size they may still show a tiny bit while running, but if nothing else the clipping is greatly reduced. I mostly made these for myself since I almost always wear long dresses, and seeing my farmer's shoes clip past the skirt has always bothered me. But no longer!

These boots were made with the idea of wearing long skirts over them, so there may be some visual bugs for some animations if you wear short skirts. I haven't tested that thoroughly yet.

These DO have visual issues on male/tall body types, specifically the back view when running. I haven't noticed any visual problems with the female/short body type, but again, I haven't tested thoroughly.

If you use long skirts then there should be no visual issues.

I plan to make another version eventually that works correctly with short skirts and pants too.


To install:
Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9969]Fashion Sense[/url]!
Unzip the file and copy "[FS] Small Boots" to your StardewValley/mods folder.
